name: Per-chapter mood setting
body: One number per chapter drives walk speed and posture, and the call's answer behaviour. Chapter 2 upright and light, chapter 5 slow and shoulders down. Posture is a body lean on the player's animator for now; an additive pose layer is the follow-up.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: Chapter 2 and chapter 5 differ in speed and posture
One setting per chapter in settings/
The festival uses it in both states
